description: Read the compact verdict/reason/policy/hash summary of an owned saved decision; the receipt signature is omitted. Use after decide_prepaid_evaluate, including lost replies; use decide_prepaid_export_record for full signed evidence. Pass the original operation_id with identical input values (JSON key order may differ), not decision_id or record_hash. Pending returns no record; missing references return RECORD_NOT_FOUND. Reads add no decision-unit debit. Requires owner-approved scoped access. Export before 90-day expiry; on RECORD_EXPIRED stop, never change IDs to bypass it. On HTTP 429 stop automatic retries and honor Retry-After; without it, ask the owner to inspect the lifetime limit. No result grants external-action authority. No credit purchases, limit changes or execution.

input.description: The complete original Rulebook request used for decide_prepaid_evaluate, including supplied optional fields. JSON object-key order is immaterial; changed or omitted values can cause OPERATION_CONFLICT. Do not reconstruct this request from the compact summary.

binding_mode.description: Optional direct binding to the supplied rules; no executable policy code.

context.description: Caller-supplied facts used by the supplied rules. Decide does not independently verify their real-world truth.

inputs.description: The rulebook-specific input names and values. Supply required facts explicitly; agents must not invent them.

mode.description: Only the declarative Rulebook mode is available.

question.description: Optional context for the proposed check; it does not change the supplied rules.

rulebook.description: Developer-supplied, approved declarative rules using the pinned Rulebook v1 contract.
rulebook.title: Decide Rulebook v1

operation_id.description: Original caller-generated operation_id from decide_prepaid_evaluate, not decision_id or record_hash. Supply the exact original input alongside it. Recover a lost pair from your trusted request journal; do not invent a replacement ID.

name: decide_prepaid_get_record

account.description: Current prepaid credit and owner/client spending limits. Available wallet credit is not the effective spending allowance.

price_per_record_microusd.description: Price per completed record; 1 USD = 1,000,000 micro-USD. Reads and identical retries add no record debit.

title: Read the original saved decision
